$comment: The data format (ADR-0001 decision 8): the compatibility tuple the server checks before using a data directory. PostgreSQL 19 RC1 (wasm32) declares dataFormat 2; earlier formats retain their original tuples under previous. PG19 adds slru_pages_per_segment to its compatibility checks and records float8ByVal as true after removing pass-by-reference float8. data-format:check verifies this declaration against an actual initdb, including the pg_control CRC and WAL page magic. Stores of format 1 must be recreated or migrated by the consuming host before adopting this build.
